era: Licensed Superbike World Championship motorcycle simulation
summary: Milestone's licensed Superbike World Championship line, from the EA-published PC simulation through the Black Bean SBK era and the modern SBK 22 revival.

entries.title: Superbike World Championship

emulation.notes: Use original Windows hardware or compatibility wrappers as needed.

primary.why: Milestone's first SBK game is a PC-only release covering the 1997 Superbike Championship with official riders, tracks, bikes, teams, variable weather, six game modes, and simulation assists. With no console or later release route sourced, the original Windows version is both the highest-fidelity and complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Windows PC release on period hardware or a modern Windows compatibility setup.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC release with the full 1997 Superbike Championship license, variable weather, simulation assists, and multiplayer support.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release and complete content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster, console port, or digital rerelease.

entries.title: Superbike 2000

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release for the primary route; DuckStation can preserve the PlayStation version if desired.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC route exceeds original PlayStation fidelity

primary.why: Superbike 2000 released for PC and PlayStation. The PC release is the higher-fidelity simulation route, while the PlayStation version has no sourced exclusive content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release on period hardware or a modern Windows compatibility setup; use PlayStation only as a console access alternative.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC simulation release with full weekend structure and configurable rider assists.
all_releases.reason: primary: higher-fidelity PC route.
skip: lower-fidelity console access route and no sourced content advantage over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced PlayStation-exclusive content requires a secondary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or complete edition.

entries.title: Superbike 2001

emulation.notes: Use original Windows hardware or compatibility wrappers as needed.

primary.why: Superbike 2001 is a Windows-only Milestone/EA release. It includes all 13 tracks, bikes from the championship manufacturers, motion-capture animation, and multiplayer; the PC release is therefore both the complete and highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Windows PC release on period hardware or a modern Windows compatibility setup.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC release with all 13 tracks, championship bikes, motion-capture animation, and multiplayer.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release and complete content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or console version.

entries.title: SBK-07: Superbike World Championship

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 for the primary PlayStation 2 route; PPSSPP preserves the PSP version.

primary.why: SBK-07 released on PlayStation 2 and PSP, with the PS2 version as the higher-fidelity home-console route. Additional PC and Xbox 360 platforms are also listed, but release summaries conflict, so the primary recommendation stays on the clearly released PS2 version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation 2 release on original hardware or PCSX2; use PSP only for portable preservation.

all_releases.fidelity: Home-console release with the 2007 official Superbike content and higher fidelity than PSP.
all_releases.reason: primary: clearest high-fidelity released route.
skip: portable access route with no sourced content advantage over PlayStation 2.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced PSP-exclusive content requires a secondary route; platform-source conflict is documented in caveats.

entries.remaster_caveats: Platform reports conflict: some name PC and Xbox 360, others name PlayStation 2 and PSP, and some treat Windows/Xbox 360 as cancelled; confidence is medium for platform history beyond the Sony releases.
